datasetVersion.termsOfAccess: The data is not available for download directly via DataverseNL. Data is available on request by completing the request form. Only data requests in line with the Terms of Use will be taken into consideration. In addition to a completed request form, the Data Sharing Agreement (DSA) in line with GDPR regulations and/or the Research Collaboration Agreement (RCA) should be signed before data is shared. If a data request is approved, the data will be delivered in a safe and secure manner. By signing the DSA and/or RCA and accessing the Materials, the recipient represents his/her acceptance of the Terms of Use.
